name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 8 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
